purpose: Persist an immutable evidence assessment of every Inventory v1 balance without opening or mutating canonical v3 stock.
invariants: one immutable candidate per migration run and qualified v1 balance source identity
source version, update time, snapshot hash, quantities, active reservations, policy and evidence reference are retained
v1 active reservation facts remain distinct from canonical reservation allocations
ASSESS never inserts or updates a v3 balance, ledger entry, or migration bridge row
identical command replay returns the immutable first result
blocked and rejected candidates always carry structured blocker codes
ASSESSED_ONLY lakehouse readiness rejects any MIGRATION_OPENING event
forbidden_shortcuts: default Owner, Warehouse, Location, Lot, or UOM
treating controlled fixtures as production history
presenting v1 reservations as canonical allocations
writing migration bridge rows before qualification
using inventory.stock.changed v3 PURCHASE_RECEIPT as a migration opening
cleanup: No destructive cleanup. Operation, run, candidates, Outbox events, lakehouse projections, and the external ledger remain audit evidence.
